comparison.objective: Respond to a visible gas warning by latching a mechanical gas shutoff while avoiding ignition controls.
comparison.physical_skill: Identifies the safe control and physically latches it; knob turning appears only as a low-scoring unsafe alternative.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires shutoff latch actuation with burners off; ignition permanently caps the score.
comparison.reason: The shared physical-control actuation is generic. This tests hazard recognition and emergency isolation, whereas the candidate requires fine tool work, preserved adjustment, and two successful measured carriage cycles. The record omits exact latch travel/force thresholds, but the objective is clearly distinct.
